pre_run_command.command: bash -c 'DANGEROUS_CMDS="rm -rf|supabase db reset|DROP TABLE|DELETE FROM|TRUNCATE|--force"; if echo "${command}" | grep -qE "$DANGEROUS_CMDS"; then echo "⚠️ BLOCKED: Potentially dangerous command detected"; echo "Command: ${command}"; exit 2; fi'
pre_run_command.description: Block dangerous commands in fintech context

pre_write_code.command: bash -c 'if echo "${file_path}" | grep -qE "(supabase/migrations|audit|security)"; then echo "📝 Writing to sensitive file: ${file_path}"; fi; exit 0'

namlend_notes: These hooks enforce safety for financial operations
- pre_write_code: Alerts on migration/security file changes
